$comment: Generated from Declaration by `magus-utils jobschema`. DO NOT EDIT; run `magus run job-generate .`.
title: magus job
description: Declaration is the typed INPUT for one lease row: the fields a caller DECLARES, and nothing the store computes. A caller cannot say when its row was created or what it released, and the way to make that true is for the input type not to carry those fields rather than for the store to strip them afterwards.

schema_version.description: Version is the newest schema any writer of this record used. A rewrite stamps the larger of the stored version and its own, so an older magus never relabels content a newer one wrote.

requires.description: Requires names the features a reader must implement to act on this record at all. A reader lacking one treats the record as read-only; the records around it stay usable. Set only for content an older reader would act on wrongly, never for an added field it can ignore.

id.description: ID is the lease's identity within the plan, the key a second register replaces on, and the only required field besides the version.

parent.description: Parent is the lease this one was spawned under, empty for a lease the root declared.

criteria.description: Criteria is what this lease is for and what done means, as one block of prose. The machine-checkable half is Goals.

checkpoint.description: Checkpoint is the working state this lease starts from, as `magus vcs checkpoint -o name` prints it.

write_paths.description: WritePaths is what this lease may write, empty on a read-only row by design. An entry `<file>#<declaration>` claims one declaration of the file (see SplitClaim).

deny_paths.description: DenyPaths are the paths inside those this lease may not write.

soft_paths.description: SoftPaths are the entries of WritePaths that are soft claims (see [Job.SoftPaths]).

read_paths.description: ReadPaths is what it may READ, widened to those projects' dependencies by the guard. Empty means write_paths stands in.

depends_on.description: DependsOn names the lease ids that must land before this one.

breaks.description: Breaks are the flags, JSON keys, exported symbols or stored formats the root approved this job breaking; empty means it breaks nothing on its own authority. See [Job.Breaks].

model.description: Model is the model or effort tier the work was matched to, a free string because hosts name their models differently.

brief_format.description: BriefFormat is the format a brief to this job's worker takes; empty defers to magus.yaml's agents.brief_format. See [Job.BriefFormat].

checkout.description: Checkout is an absolute directory, outside the workspace, where the fork makes a new checkout of the repository for this job at its checkpoint, or at the forking checkout's revision when it names none. The job owns it: see [JobWorktree]. Empty works wherever the job is taken.

owned_paths.description: LegacyWritePaths is the pre-rename spelling of write_paths, accepted on input and never emitted.

forbidden_paths.description: LegacyDenyPaths is the pre-rename spelling of deny_paths. compat: see LegacyWritePaths.

focus.description: LegacyReadPaths is the pre-rename spelling of read_paths. compat: see LegacyWritePaths.

tier.description: LegacyModel is the pre-rename spelling of model. compat: see LegacyWritePaths.

target.description: Target is the magus target the check runs, without the `magus run` in front of it. Empty when Script names the check instead.

script.description: Script is a Buzz script the check runs with `magus buzz --record` in place of a target, for a fact no target checks: a passing recorded run of it is the evidence. A check names a target or a script, never both.

project.description: Project is the project the target runs in, "." when the row names none.

args.description: Args are forwarded to the tool after `--`, never to magus.

no_default_charms.description: NoDefaultCharms runs the check with --no-default-charms, so only a run made without the workspace's default_charms satisfies it: the charmless `generate` that compares against HEAD, in a workspace whose default is rw.

check.description: Check is the one check this lease runs, and acceptance binds a worker's evidence to it.

state.description: State is the row's lifecycle position, empty for a row that has not said where it stands. no_return is a lease that never reported, which is not a failure.

read_only.description: ReadOnly marks a lease that gathers evidence and writes nothing, so empty write paths are correct rather than missing.

validation.description: Validation is the check as a rendered `magus run` line.

kind.description: Kind names WHAT this goal examines and Expect names what must be true of it. Two fields rather than one, because the alternative is a kind per pair: `paths` beside `exists` beside `absent` beside `no-symbol`, which is a vocabulary that grows by multiplication and reads inconsistently the moment it has four members.

expect.description: Expect is optional and defaults to the kind's own: passed for check, changed for paths and symbol. The common goal names only its kind and its subject.

target.description: Target is the magus target the check runs, without the `magus run` in front of it. Empty when Script names the check instead.

script.description: Script is a Buzz script the check runs with `magus buzz --record` in place of a target, for a fact no target checks: a passing recorded run of it is the evidence. A check names a target or a script, never both.

project.description: Project is the project the target runs in, "." when the row names none.

args.description: Args are forwarded to the tool after `--`, never to magus.

no_default_charms.description: NoDefaultCharms runs the check with --no-default-charms, so only a run made without the workspace's default_charms satisfies it: the charmless `generate` that compares against HEAD, in a workspace whose default is rw.

check.description: Check is the run a GoalKindCheck goal examines. Zero on every other kind.

paths.description: Paths are the globs a GoalKindPaths goal examines. Zero on every other kind.

symbols.description: Symbols are the names a GoalKindSymbol goal examines, as the knowledge graph resolves them. Zero on every other kind.

signature.description: Signature is the declaration an ExpectSignature goal holds its one symbol to, in the form the symbol index renders it. A fork that declares none records the indexed one, which is how a stub the root wrote becomes the contract. Zero on every other goal.

goals.description: Goals are what done means, graded by `magus job wait`. See [Job.Goals].

timeout.description: Timeout bounds the lease, as a Go duration. The store stamps Job.Deadline from it when it writes the row, so a declaration carries a length and never an instant. Empty is no bound; there is no default here (a workspace may set jobs.default_timeout).

max_attempts.description: MaxAttempts caps how many times the job may be forked, its first fork included; zero is no cap. See [Job.MaxAttempts].

waivers.description: Waivers accept waivable problems (see [Waivable]) on the record's own authority.

enter.description: Enter turns the record into an entry rather than a declaration: it acknowledges one write into this path, inside the write paths of the live job ID names, by somebody other than its holder. A record carrying it declares nothing else.
